title_original: Rising Borrowing Costs Shouldn’t Delay Your Security: Meet Firewall-as-a-Subscription
description: Check Point’s Firewall-as-a-Subscription Puts Advanced AI-Era Protection Within Reach of Every Organization Attacks don’t wait for budget approval. But firewall purchases often do, and that wait is getting longer. Rising interest rates have made borrowing more expensive. For a midsize company, a single rate rise can cost the equivalent of a branch office firewall. A large hardware purchase now means a harder conversation with finance and a longer approval cycle. Meanwhile, the old firewall stays in place; the network grows, and so does the risk. Security is urgent. The way organizations pay for it isn’t keeping pace. description: Executive summary CERT-FR’s October 13 update reports compromises of refrigeration controllers, naming Danfoss AK-SM and AK-SC alongside Copeland/Dixell XWEB systems.
